page.notes: External URL redirects to /uk. Public recipe content is server rendered. Coverage includes home, search listing, recipe detail, auth entry, premium entry, and 404 recovery; localized duplicates, post-auth authoring/account pages, third-party identity providers, and payment execution were not covered.

paths.description: Localized UK home and discovery surface: navigation, search entry, banners, trends, consent, desktop/mobile and preference conditions.
Primary recipe-discovery journey and listing template, using the Chicken results page; includes repeated infinite-scroll interaction.
Representative recipe detail and core content-consumption task, including metadata, mobile layout and no-JavaScript crawler view.
Guest sign-up/login entry surface, representing authentication choices. Third-party identity-provider completion was excluded because it leaves Cookpad and requires credentials.
Premium/listing surface and visible subscription entry points. Post-auth purchase/account cancellation was excluded because credentials and a transaction would be required.
Representative HTTP failure/recovery state on an unknown route.

findings.summary: The site does not honour the user’s dark colour-scheme preference.
findings.evidence: The dark-condition screenshot is pixel-identical in palette to the light screenshot, and the platform probe found no prefers-color-scheme rule or color-scheme declaration.
findings.suggestedFix: Declare color-scheme and provide preference-driven dark surface/text tokens with prefers-color-scheme or light-dark().

findings.summary: There is no explicit high-contrast or forced-colours adaptation.
findings.evidence: The platform probe found no prefers-contrast or forced-colors rules; Lighthouse also measured text/button contrast as low as 2.13:1.
findings.suggestedFix: Add forced-colors and prefers-contrast adaptations, preserve native control colours, and strengthen low-contrast tokens.

findings.summary: Route and state changes do not use View Transitions.
findings.evidence: The live CSS probe found no view-transition declarations and no active transition animations on the representative home surface.
findings.suggestedFix: Use same-document and cross-document View Transitions for route/detail changes, with reduced-motion fallbacks.

findings.summary: The banner carousel uses small custom pagination rather than a platform-aligned, touch-friendly scrolling interaction.
findings.evidence: The mobile screenshot shows an interactive carousel; CSS had no scroll-snap, while Lighthouse measured its pagination controls at only 8–10px.
findings.suggestedFix: Use a scroll-snap carousel with adequately sized controls and native scrolling behaviour.

findings.summary: Sticky navigation does not adapt to scroll state.
findings.evidence: DOM evidence shows a sticky header, but the CSS probe found no scroll-state query, scroll timeline, or progress affordance.
findings.suggestedFix: Use scroll-state container queries or a lightweight declarative progress/shrinking treatment where the long listing and recipe pages benefit.

findings.summary: Transient consent and navigation UI use custom containers rather than modern semantic overlay primitives.
findings.evidence: The loaded page exposes no dialog, popover, or details elements even though the fixed cookie consent panel and mobile navigation are dismissible transient UI.
findings.suggestedFix: Use dialog/popover semantics and declarative light-dismiss where appropriate, retaining explicit accept/refuse actions.

findings.summary: Responsive components rely on viewport styling only.
findings.evidence: The representative components visibly rearrange between mobile and desktop, but live CSS inspection found no @container rules or container-type declarations.
findings.suggestedFix: Introduce container queries for reusable recipe cards, sidebars, and action groups that appear in differently sized parents.

findings.summary: Carousel controls are too small for reliable touch input.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse measured four mobile pagination buttons at 8–10px with less than 24px safe clickable space. Keyboard focus itself was visible.
findings.suggestedFix: Keep the visual dots small if desired, but expand each interactive hit area to at least 24px and preferably 44px.

findings.summary: Lab Core Web Vitals are outside the good range on key templates.
findings.evidence: Mobile Lighthouse measured home LCP 5.4s and CLS 0.17; recipe LCP 3.6s and CLS 0.16. Both exceed good thresholds.
findings.suggestedFix: Prioritise the LCP element, shorten dependency chains, and reserve stable space for late content.

findings.summary: Both home and recipe templates shift materially during load.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse recorded CLS 0.170 on home and 0.160 on recipe even though the later five-second layout observer saw no additional shifts.
findings.suggestedFix: Reserve dimensions for all initial media/chrome and diagnose Lighthouse layout-shift elements before hydration or font swaps.

findings.summary: Third-party scripts and render-blocking font styles delay critical delivery.
findings.evidence: The HAR recorded 930KB across 64 requests; GTM took 1.14s and 186KB, Facebook 108KB, and two Typekit stylesheets were parser-inserted at VeryHigh priority.
findings.suggestedFix: Self-host/subset fonts, minimise blocking styles, and delay analytics until consent or idle where business requirements allow.

findings.summary: Third-party JavaScript dominates a substantial share of the home load.
findings.evidence: Scripts account for 461KB; GTM and Facebook alone transfer about 294KB, while the home page’s main task is simple recipe discovery.
findings.suggestedFix: Audit tag usage, remove duplicate/unneeded tags, and conditionally load analytics only when needed.

findings.summary: Core navigation and recipe controls have invalid or missing accessible semantics.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse found invalid tablist/tab relationships, unnamed banner links/images on home, an unnamed recipe back button, and aria-hidden content containing a focusable app link.
findings.suggestedFix: Use native list/navigation semantics, provide names for icon controls and linked images, and remove hidden descendants from the tab order.

findings.summary: Text and primary action colours fail WCAG contrast.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse measured white on Cookpad orange at 2.13:1, orange text on the recipe surface at 2.07:1, and secondary text at 2.88–4.42:1.
findings.suggestedFix: Darken the orange/secondary tokens or change foreground colours until normal text reaches at least 4.5:1 and essential UI reaches 3:1.

findings.summary: Page landmarks, headings, and list semantics are not logically structured.
findings.evidence: Both Lighthouse runs report no main landmark; home contains two H1s, and recipe ingredients are li elements overridden with role=paragraph, invalidating their list.
findings.suggestedFix: Add one main landmark, one page-level H1 per template, and retain native list semantics for ingredients/navigation.

findings.summary: Small carousel targets weaken reflowed/touch use.
findings.evidence: The 390px layouts had no horizontal overflow, but Lighthouse’s target-size audit found 8–10px pagination buttons with insufficient spacing.
findings.suggestedFix: Enlarge target hit areas without changing the compact visual marker and verify at 200% zoom.

findings.summary: Some image assets are incorrectly sized or lack intrinsic dimensions.
findings.evidence: The image probes found two home images without dimensions, and Lighthouse found a recipe avatar displayed at a distorted 14×16 ratio instead of 1:1.
findings.suggestedFix: Set correct width/height or aspect-ratio on every image and avoid stretching avatars.

findings.summary: The localized home has inconsistent canonical/sitemap signals.
findings.evidence: The UK page declares canonical https://cookpad.com/eng, Lighthouse flags it invalid, and https://cookpad.com/sitemap.xml returns HTTP 404. Recipe canonical and metadata are valid.
findings.suggestedFix: Give each indexable locale a valid self/cluster canonical strategy, publish sitemap indexes, and reference them from robots.txt.

findings.summary: The main document is served without Content-Security-Policy.
findings.evidence: The headers primitive confirms HTTPS, HSTS, nosniff and SAMEORIGIN, but no Content-Security-Policy header.
findings.suggestedFix: Deploy a nonce/hash-based CSP, beginning in report-only mode, then enforce it without unsafe-inline/unsafe-eval.

findings.summary: Tracking code loads before the user chooses a cookie preference.
findings.evidence: A fresh guest load requested Google Tag Manager and Facebook tracking code; tracker evidence lists six third-party origins and the HAR attributes about 294KB to GTM/Facebook.
findings.suggestedFix: Gate non-essential analytics behind refusal-aware consent and minimise/batch events.

findings.summary: Guest authentication offers federated identity or email, but no passkey option.
findings.evidence: The auth surface offers Google, Apple, Facebook, and Email; the inspected markup exposes no WebAuthn/passkey path. No permission prompt fired on load.
findings.suggestedFix: Add discoverable passkey registration/authentication and conditional UI alongside existing recovery methods.

findings.summary: Permissions-Policy is absent.
findings.evidence: The headers primitive found HSTS, clickjacking protection and Referrer-Policy, but no Permissions-Policy header.
findings.suggestedFix: Send a restrictive Permissions-Policy allowing only capabilities required by Cookpad and trusted origins.

findings.summary: Image delivery is not consistently responsive or format-efficient.
findings.evidence: Home has 17 images without srcset and 24 legacy-format images; recipe has 39 without srcset and 86 legacy-format images, plus the hero fetched at 300px but displayed as wide as 780px in the probe.
findings.suggestedFix: Serve AVIF/WebP picture sources with width-based srcset/sizes and match intrinsic resolution to rendered size.

findings.summary: Analytics and social tracking consume disproportionate bytes on a simple discovery page.
findings.evidence: GTM (186KB) and Facebook (108KB) are the first and third largest transferred resources; all third-party origins account for 910KB under the harness’s origin classification.
findings.suggestedFix: Set a third-party byte budget, defer tags until consent/idle, and remove tags that do not produce actionable value.

findings.summary: Repeated infinite-scroll traversal grows retained heap substantially without evidence of release.
findings.evidence: Heap summaries rose from 24.9MB/425k nodes at baseline to 35.8MB/610k after one bottom traversal and 51.0MB/882k after ten. Growth is consistent with retained loaded results; it may be intentional rather than a detached-node leak, but remains unbounded for a long session.
findings.suggestedFix: Virtualise or prune off-screen result cards and bound caches; repeat the same cycle in one session with allocation/retainer analysis to verify release.

taskList.title: Repair semantic structure, accessible names, contrast, focus visibility, and touch target sizing
Improve LCP and eliminate initial layout shifts on home and recipe templates
Bound infinite-list DOM and retained-memory growth with virtualization or pruning
Gate and reduce analytics/social tags; establish third-party budgets
Add responsive image sources, modern formats, intrinsic sizing, and correct aspect ratios
Add CSP and Permissions-Policy, then introduce passkey authentication
Correct localized canonical and sitemap signals
Modernise carousel/navigation motion, touch interaction, and scroll-state feedback
Adopt semantic transient UI and component container queries
